description: Value-conservation / arithmetic knife-edges extending the mint/burn family (uncovered by it): ADA-side value-conservation off-by-one, and signed-int64 mint boundary (2^63-1) + overflow (2^63). amaru ACCEPTING value creation/overflow that cardano rejects is CRITICAL. Graded by mint_burn_differential (verdict -> reason-class -> parity, fail-closed).

cases.note: output ADA = balanced + 1 lovelace (creates value); mint 10 == output 10 MINT. amaru-accept = CRITICAL (ada from nothing)
mint 2^63 MINT (out of signed-int64 range); both must decode-reject. amaru-accept = CRITICAL value creation via overflow
mint 2^63-1 MINT, output carries it (valid signed-int64 max, value-conserved) -> both accept
